notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch notes:


Humans can't shoot through allies anymore (should add some difficulty + a level of strategy)
Improved ranged units targeting system (ranged units make better choices)
Added permanent bodies setting
Fixed a bug where the player could control time while game was paused
Reduced max concurrent sounds
 Updated to Unity 2019.3

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Fixed a bug where baby UI card shows up after a mission fail on campaign mode, allowing the player to move the baby.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Release note:

- Fixed a bug where mouse cursor disappears when switching level on Campaign mode.

notes.title: Release 1.0: Campaign!
notes.content:
Release note:

- Added Campaign!
- Fixed a bug where zombies would disappear when player spawns an insane number of zombies (200,000+)

notes.title: Update 0.9.2: New Maps!
notes.content:
Release note:

 Added 5 new maps
 Modified camera behaviour during battle setup
 Added zoom control with scroll wheel
 Freeze time when battle ends

notes.title: Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
Changelog:

 Fixed a bug where zombies would go through obstacles when zombie count is very high (200,000+) and game speed is x4
 Optimized targeting system for humans
 Reduced concurrent sounds limit
